items.desc: Kenyan health officials said the 65-year-old ​woman was a close ‌relative of a ‌​man who died of Ebola last month. The woman developed symptoms ‌while under quarantine in Nairobi.

items.title: Trump eases Canada tariffs ahead of US midterms
items.titleOrig: Trump eases Canada tariffs ahead of US midterms
items.desc: The move comes as Trump's Republican Party scrambles to maintain control of the US Congress, with a Republican candidate in a key Senate race saying she had lobbied to lift the tariffs on Canadian products.

items.desc: Russia's attacks on the Ukrainian capital are hitting harder and more frequently, making 2026 one of the long war's bloodiest years for Kyiv. DW asked people on the ground what life is like.

items.title: Jordan: Karak church shooting leaves 7 dead, dozens injured
items.titleOrig: Jordan: Karak church shooting leaves 7 dead, dozens injured
items.desc: A shooting at a Greek Orthodox church in southern Jordan happened during a funeral, according to authorities. Two unidentified men opened fire on the procession, with Jordan's king vowing "the harshest retaliation."

items.title: Russia, Ukraine agree to US-brokered, 1 city ceasefire
items.titleOrig: Russia, Ukraine agree to US-brokered, 1 city ceasefire
items.desc: The Ukrainian city of Oleshky, occupied by Russia and on the frontline, faces a humanitarian crisis. The localized truce comes as Ukrainian President Zelenskyy said negotiators would meet for wider talks next month.

items.title: Afghan women could lose one of their last paths to a higher education
items.titleOrig: Afghan women could lose one of their last paths to a higher education
items.desc: The US has defunded one of the last universities giving Afghan women the chance to receive an education after the Taliban takeover in 2021. DW spoke with a student who says she's lost hope of ever earning a degree.

items.title: Romania blames Russia for ship attack in the Black Sea
items.titleOrig: Romania blames Russia for ship attack in the Black Sea
items.desc: Russian strikes against ships attempting to export Ukrainian grain and cargo through the western Black Sea have sharply increased this month.

items.title: Ukraine tries to shut Moscow's airports with drone strikes on Russia
items.titleOrig: Ukraine tries to shut Moscow's airports with drone strikes on Russia
items.desc: Repeated Ukrainian drone attacks are increasingly disrupting operations at Moscow's airports. The pounding is part of Ukraine's plan to shut down Russia's airpace.

items.title: Many feared trapped under collapsed building in Nairobi
items.titleOrig: Many feared trapped under collapsed building in Nairobi
items.desc: People are feared to be trapped after a large, unfinished building in Nairobi collapsed during construction. Rescue operations have proven complicated as police fired tear gas to disperse looters.

items.title: Japan-Russia ties erode as journalist sits in Moscow jail
items.titleOrig: Japan-Russia ties erode as journalist sits in Moscow jail
items.desc: Japan is demanding access to a journalist who was arrested by Russian security services. The Kremlin claims that Japan is using journalists as spies.

items.titleOrig: Uganda says it has no active Ebola cases, but infections in Kenya and Nigeria are prompting fresh scrutiny

items.title: Serbia: Hope, tension and apprehension as voters prepare to elect new parliament
items.titleOrig: Serbia: Hope, tension and apprehension as voters prepare to elect new parliament
items.desc: After two years of protests, Serbia faces a pivotal election on Sunday, with a student-led challenge to Aleksandar Vucic's lengthy rule. Allegations of electoral irregularities and fears of a post-election crisis abound.

items.title: France: 1 killed, 4 wounded after shooting near Paris
items.titleOrig: France: 1 killed, 4 wounded after shooting near Paris
items.desc: French police arrested a suspect after gunshots were fired on the outskirts of Paris in what President Macron described as a racist and terrorist attack.

items.title: Sri Lanka: Death of iconic elephant raises habitat concerns
items.titleOrig: Sri Lanka: Death of iconic elephant raises habitat concerns
items.desc: The death of what was thought to be Sri Lanka’s largest elephant has drawn attention to human-elephant conflict in rural communities. The island country sees a high number of deadly encounters.
